name: performance

findings.message: Every cycle iteration on every run (including fresh runs) now pays an extra `locked_state_update` (flock + jq subprocess + atomic rename) at iteration start, even though for a completed iteration the end-of-iter write (`_cycle_state_write_iter_atomic`) already overwrites `current_iter` with the same value, making the start write pure overhead for the common case.

reason: the performance lens found no medium or high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
